summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Swasth Triage Sandbox. Wrote a full pytest suite (19 tests) covering triage LLM behaviour (Emergency/Urgent/Routine/Self-care escalation, no over-escalation, Hindi/Hinglish support), facility filtering/nearest routing, CSV import (+cleanup), case logs and validation. All 19 backend tests pass. Ran Playwright end-to-end for the 4 tabs, all 3 required presets (chest-pain Emergency + call_108 + red_flags + facility cards, fever = Urgent, minor-cut = Self-care), case-log urgency filter, row expansion, facility directory search/district/type filters, and the API playground POST /triage flow — all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_case route is declared AFTER /cases/stats — good ordering (Starlette matches in-order), no issue. But note that /api/cases/{case_ref} matches any string incl. 'stats' if reordered; keep the current order.

geo.resolve_location with pincode-area fallback returns the centroid of all facilities sharing the first 3 digits — this can be far from the actual pincode (regional centroid). Acceptable for a sandbox but note this in production docs.

/api/facilities/import always inserts even when replace=false without any dedup on (name+pincode) — repeated CSV uploads can create duplicates in production. Consider unique index or upsert on site_code.
TriageRequest.severity_reported has no bounds validation (1-10). Callers can send 999 and it silently propagates. Add Field(ge=1, le=10).
TriageRequest.age has no bounds (0-120). Consider adding Field(ge=0, le=120).
CaseRecord.created_at is stored as ISO string; sorting by string works for ISO but a native datetime with proper index would be more robust.
startup event uses deprecated @app.on_event; consider FastAPI lifespan handlers.
No pagination or total-count metadata on GET /api/cases and /api/facilities responses.
seed_data_creation: CSV import test inserted 2 TEST_Facility_Import_* rows and cleaned them up afterwards. Facility count restored to 36.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and can be re-run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Triage tests each hit real Claude Sonnet 4.6 (~10-25s), full suite finishes in ~50s under xdist. LLM latency ranges: chest-pain ~10-15s, playground ~10s. Facility count MUST stay at 36 — CSV import test cleans up via pymongo directly using DB_NAME 'test_database' (quotes stripped). Any new imports should be prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. All required features from the review request work correctly: (1) Hinglish chest-pain -> Emergency + call_108 + 4 red_flags + nearest facilities sorted ascending with maps_url + 0.0 km for exact pincode. (2) Hindi fever 4d/sev6/Tinsukia -> Urgent (not Emergency), detected_language Hindi. (3) Mild headache sev2 -> Self-care with 0-1 red_flags. (4) District-only resolves via centroid. (5) No location -> 200 with empty nearest & null resolved_location. (6) symptom_notes < 3 -> 422. (7) GET /api/meta = 18 districts + 36 facilities. (8) GET /api/facilities returns 'id' not '_id'. (9) /api/facilities/nearest?pincode=785004 = 0.0km first. (10) unresolvable location -> 422. (11) CSV import works, missing-columns -> 400. (12) /api/cases newest-first, urgency filter, stats, 404 on unknown ref. UI: all 4 nav tabs + presets + filters + playground work with correct data-testids.
